description: This file defines an interface `PubSubConfig` that specifies configuration settings for a pub-sub system within an Eclipse Ditto-based project. It includes methods for accessing configuration parameters such as seed value, hash family size, restart delay, update interval, and force update probability. It also contains static factory methods to create `PubSubConfig` instances from a `Config` object or an `ActorSystem`. Additionally, it defines an enum `ConfigValue` that provides default configuration values and paths for these settings.

classes.name: PubSubConfig
classes.description: Interface for configuration related to distributed pub-sub system, providing methods to retrieve configuration parameters and static factory methods.

classes.name: ConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of known configuration path expressions and their default values for the pub-sub configuration.

methods.name: getSeed
methods.description: Returns the seed value used for hashing functions shared across the cluster.

methods.name: getHashFamilySize
methods.description: Returns the number of hash functions used for Bloom filters.

methods.name: getRestartDelay
methods.description: Returns the duration to wait before restarting pub-sub actors after a crash.

methods.name: getUpdateInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval at which distributed data is updated.

methods.name: getForceUpdateProbability
methods.description: Returns the probability of forcing an update on each clock tick.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static method to create a PubSubConfig instance from a Config object at the 'pubsub' path.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static method to create a PubSubConfig instance from an ActorSystem's configuration at the 'ditto.pubsub' path.
